    Dimension shifting across a projective middle term #

    A short exact sequence 0 ⟶ K ⟶ P ⟶ X ⟶ 0 with projective middle term induces the natural linear equivalence

    Extⁿ⁺¹(K,Y) ≃ Extⁿ⁺²(X,Y).

    Function.Bijective ⇑(hS.extClass.precompOfLinear k Y ⋯)

    The connecting map in positive degree is bijective when the middle term of the short exact sequence is projective.
